python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
sw = section.to_manifold(w)
print('before', sw.volume(), np.reshape(sw.bounding_box(),(2,3))[1])
M = np.eye(4); M[:2,:2] = [[0.95630476,0.2923717],[-0.2923717,0.95630476]]
sw2 = sw.transform(M[:3])
print('after orig bbox max', np.reshape(sw.bounding_box(),(2,3))[1])
print('new bbox max', np.reshape(sw2.bounding_box(),(2,3))[1])
print('same object?', sw is sw2)
"
